benchmarks.name: OCRBench
benchmarks.config: Native scale, NOT the figure's normalized value: the card's own cohort table prints OCRBench* 757 / 726 out of 1000 (LLM-judge / strict); this row takes the LLM-judge figure. The bar figure normalizes it to 75.7 on a 0-100 axis (75.7 = 757/1000). Cross-checked against the card text table by tools/verify_scores.py, which aligns this benchmark at /1000.

benchmarks.name: DocVQA
benchmarks.config: Read off the card's 17-panel bar figure; read by eye, caveat +-0.5. Every value second-read from a 2x upscaled crop of its own panel and matched exactly. Figure states all scores are normalized to 0-100 (MME* /2800, OCRBench* /1000), so scale is 100 for every row including MME. Column identity: VisionPsy-Nano-460M is the black bar, first in each cluster; the eight rows already on file reproduce those black bars exactly, which anchors the column. Aggregates (Document/Perception/Reasoning/Instruction category averages) skipped as they double count.
